payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over possible lengths of c and b derived from length constraints, uses modular arithmetic to quickly verify a+b=c, and returns first match.
payload.rationale: The solution reduces the search space by considering only plausible lengths for c and b (lc in range, lb close to lc) and checks using modular hashing. It is not full backtracking or branch-and-bound but is closest to branch-and-bound among the given subtypes.
